explication: headscale-admin is a browser-side administrative UI for Headscale; the hosted static app does not itself proxy API traffic. Administrators configure the Headscale endpoint and API key, then manage users, nodes, routes, ACL policy, and deployment settings through the interface. The graph preserves these product areas and the sampled API/ACL paths. Unsampled page implementations are represented by their exact route paths; links from those pages to data operations are omitted where excerpts do not establish them.
